encoding: UTF-8 JSON encoded in gzip format; client fetches raw bytes and decompresses with DecompressionStream('gzip'); node tests use zlib.gunzipSync.
originalTitlePreservation: Each item in compressed array stores original CSV row index, exact title_unchanged and collection integer referencing collections table. Duplicate occurrences and punctuation remain. Raw source IDs and withheld entries are absent.
privacy: Only original rows whose privacy_unchanged === general are exported. Counts for withheld titles are aggregated.
collectionCounts: The other side of the mirror
note: 719 G titles include 713 general and 6 withheld. 604 public entries are in one Family Grove source collection and must not be reported as 604 unique finished apps.
